evals.name: coin-tapper-full-audit
evals.prompt: im launching my coin tapper sim next week and running ads on it. can you check everything robux related in {REPO} so we dont accidentally scam kids? dont change any code just tell me whats wrong
evals.expected_output: A ranked report with a 'not safe yet' verdict that finds the planted bugs and doesn't flag the honest BEST VALUE tag.

assertions.name: granted-when-player-missing
assertions.text: Flags that ProcessReceipt returns PurchaseGranted when the player isn't in the server (ShopService) as a charged-for-nothing bug

assertions.name: save-result-ignored
assertions.text: Flags that PurchaseGranted is returned even if DataService:Save fails (the pcall result is ignored)

assertions.name: no-receipt-dedupe
assertions.text: Flags that PurchaseId is never stored/checked, so a retried receipt grants twice

assertions.name: failed-load-wipes-save
assertions.text: Flags that a failed GetAsync starts fresh data that is later saved over the real save

assertions.name: no-session-lock-or-bindtoclose
assertions.text: Flags the missing session lock (GetAsync/SetAsync, server hopping) and/or the missing BindToClose

assertions.name: currency-not-policy-gated
assertions.text: Flags that coin bundles (and/or the starter coins) are sold with no PolicyService check although coins buy random eggs

assertions.name: lucky-egg-policy
assertions.text: Flags the LUCKY EGG pass as a paid random item with no odds shown before purchase and/or no PolicyService gate

assertions.name: double-coins-scope
assertions.text: Flags that 2x COINS promises 'EVERYTHING' but only doubles tapping (not quests / daily chest)

assertions.name: vip-tag-missing
assertions.text: Flags that the Starter Pack's VIP chat tag is never shown (the VIP attribute is set but ChatTags never reads it)

assertions.name: price-label-mismatch
assertions.text: Flags that the 10,000 Coins card says R$ 99 while the product costs R$ 149

assertions.name: fake-was-price
assertions.text: Flags the 'WAS R$ 999' crossed-out price as an invented reference price

assertions.name: claim-starter-exploit
assertions.text: Flags the ClaimStarterBonus remote as a free-starter-pack exploit (trusts a client flag)

assertions.name: loss-chasing-prompt
assertions.text: Flags RoundEndUI prompting a coin purchase right after losing a round

assertions.name: no-false-best-value
assertions.text: Does NOT call the BEST VALUE tag on 50,000 Coins false (it is the best coins per R$)

assertions.name: verdict-not-safe
assertions.text: Gives a clear verdict that it is not safe to sell yet (or only with fixes)

assertions.name: item-table
assertions.text: Includes a table/list of every item (4 products + 2 passes) with a status

assertions.name: scenarios
assertions.text: The must-fix findings each come with a concrete player scenario

assertions.name: no-code-edits
assertions.text: No file in the repo was edited

evals.name: pet-hatchery-state-bugs
evals.prompt: Before I publish Pet Hatchery, please audit the purchase code in {REPO}. Is it safe to sell? I want a report I can work from.
evals.expected_output: A report that finds the state/timing bugs and the farmable refund, and marks the (correct) save layer and receipt idempotency as fine.

assertions.name: inventory-full-granted
assertions.text: Flags that a pet purchase with a full inventory returns PurchaseGranted with only a toast (charged for nothing)

assertions.name: pending-not-saved
assertions.text: Flags that the Gem Shop's pending Robux deal lives only in memory (not saved before the prompt)

assertions.name: single-pending-slot
assertions.text: Flags that one pending slot per player is overwritten by a second tap, so a slow receipt gets the wrong deal / the refund

assertions.name: refund-farmable
assertions.text: Flags the no-deal fallback (robux * 2 gems) as farmable: self-prompting the product gives more gems than it costs

assertions.name: starter-fake-scarcity
assertions.text: Flags the starter countdown as fake (restarts every join, not tied to firstJoin) and/or the 24 h window never being enforced on the server

assertions.name: triple-credit-lost
assertions.text: Flags that a TRIPLE HATCH credit is spent before the inventory-full check, so it can be lost

assertions.name: pass-not-applied-until-rejoin
assertions.text: Flags that passes bought in game aren't applied until the next join (no PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished)

assertions.name: daily-egg-web-restricted
assertions.text: Flags that a restricted player who buys DAILY EGG (e.g. on the website) gets nothing

assertions.name: gems-not-policy-gated
assertions.text: Flags that Gems100 / the starter gems are sold without a PolicyService check although gems buy random eggs

assertions.name: save-layer-fine
assertions.text: Does NOT flag the session-locked SaveService, receipt de-dupe or NotProcessedYet-on-missing-player as must-fix bugs (it treats them as working)

assertions.name: safe-refund-fix
assertions.text: The suggested fix for the refund never pays more than the R$ charged (or keys deals so no fallback is needed)

assertions.name: verdict-not-safe
assertions.text: Gives a clear verdict that it is not safe to sell yet (or only with fixes)

assertions.name: no-code-edits
assertions.text: No file in the repo was edited

evals.name: coin-tapper-narrow-ask
evals.prompt: my friend said my starter pack might be kinda misleading lol. can u look at the robux stuff in {REPO}
evals.expected_output: Still a full Robux audit: the starter problems plus the receipt/save bugs that also affect the starter.

assertions.name: vip-tag-missing
assertions.text: Flags that the Starter Pack's VIP chat tag never appears

assertions.name: claim-starter-exploit
assertions.text: Flags the ClaimStarterBonus remote as a free-starter-pack exploit

assertions.name: receipt-core-bugs
assertions.text: Also flags at least one ProcessReceipt bug (Granted when the player is missing, save result ignored, or no PurchaseId de-dupe)

assertions.name: beyond-starter
assertions.text: Covers Robux items beyond the starter pack (bundles and/or passes)

assertions.name: no-code-edits
assertions.text: No file in the repo was edited
